999008199.text: 社の大掃除を手伝いたいだと？

localizations.en: You wish to help clean the shrine?

999008199.text:
はい！　ケイウン特有の年末の迎え方だと
本で読みました！

localizations.en: Yes! I read in a book that this is a unique Keiun tradition for welcoming the new year!

999008199.text:
１年の穢れを払い、新年を迎える大切な行事とのこと、
ぜひ参加させていただければ！

localizations.en: It's an important ritual to purify the year's impurities and welcome the new year. We'd be honored to participate!

999008199.text:
これも祈りの行事。星の案内人としても
しかと体験させていただきたい所存です！

localizations.en: This is also a prayer ritual. As a Star Guide, I'd like to experience it firsthand!

999008199.text:
ははは。そう畏まらなくていい。ケイウンの文化を
そう評されれば、悪い気はしない

localizations.en: Hahaha. No need to be so formal. I'm pleased to hear you speak so highly of Keiun's culture.

999008199.text: 遠慮なく、手伝いを頼むとしよう
はいっ！
はいっ！

そういえば、ここは花が満開なんですね。
この季節に咲く花なんですか？

localizations.en: Come to think of it, the flowers here are in full bloom. Do they normally blossom this time of year?

999008199.text:
見事だろう。これは桜という花でな。
本来は暖かくなった頃に咲く花なんだ

localizations.en: Magnificent, aren't they? These are cherry blossoms. They typically bloom when the weather warms up.

999008199.text:
鏑矢様が、アトリエで知り合った錬金術士様から
「花咲く粉」をいただきまして

localizations.en: Master Kaburaya received "blooming powder" from an alchemist he met at an atelier.

999008199.text: なんと、錬金術で咲かせていた花だった！

localizations.en: Whoa, so they made these flowers bloom with alchemy!

999008199.text: 桜が咲き乱れる中、新年を迎えるのも一興だろう！

localizations.en: Welcoming the new year surrounded by cherry blossoms in full bloom—quite a sight, wouldn't you say?

999008199.text: はい。幻想的でとっても素敵です！

localizations.en: Yes. It's fantastical and absolutely beautiful!

999008199.text: この「桜」もケイウン名物っすね！

localizations.en: These cherry blossoms are a Keiun specialty too!

999008199.text:
幻想的っていえば、レスナのその晴れ着も見事だね。
いつもと雰囲気が違って、美しいよ

localizations.en: Speaking of fantastical, that festive outfit of yours is quite stunning, Resna. You look different from usual—truly beautiful.

999008199.text: はい。とてもお似合いです

localizations.en: Yes. It suits you very well.

999008199.text:
母から贈られた衣装なんです。
ケイウンの衣装とも似ていると思い、着てみまして

localizations.en: It's an outfit my mother gave me. I thought it looked similar to Keiun's clothing, so I decided to wear it.

999008199.text:
ああ、見事だ。我が国の品が
お前の手に渡ったのかもしれぬ。これも縁だな

localizations.en: Indeed, it's magnificent. Perhaps goods from our country reached your mother's hands. Another connection between us.

999008199.text: そうだとしたら、素敵ですね！
うんうん。すっごく綺麗。いいな～

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah. You look amazing. I'm so jealous!

999008199.text:
ふふ、ありがとう。じゃあ今度、私から何か
アルビーナに贈るね

localizations.en: Hehe, thank you. In that case, I'll give you something next time.

999008199.text: やったぁ！

しかし鏑矢様。レスナ殿のせっかくの美しい晴れ着、
大掃除で汚れてしまうのでは？

localizations.en: However, Master Kaburaya, won't Resna's beautiful outfit get dirty during the cleaning?

999008199.text:
ふむ。千歳、晴れ着で掃除できそうな場所を
見繕ってやれ

localizations.en: Hmm. Chitose, find them places to clean where their outfits won't get soiled.

999008199.text: はい。レスナ様、アルビーナ様。こちらへ……

localizations.en: Yes. Resna, Alvina, this way, please...

999008199.text: か、かえって気を遣わせてしまい、恐縮しきりです

localizations.en: W-we're sorry for causing you extra trouble.

999008199.text:
静かな社。清浄な空気。なんだか掃除しながら
こっちの心まで洗われてくよーな

localizations.en: The quiet shrine... The pure air... It almost feels like cleaning this place purifies our hearts too.

999008199.text:
年末の大切な行事なのも頷けるよね。
私もこれから毎年やろうかな

localizations.en: I can see why this is such an important year-end ritual. Maybe I should start doing this every year too.

999008199.text: アトリエ大掃除とか？

あ、それもいいな！　１年間ずーっとお世話に
なってる場所だもんね

localizations.en: Ah, that's a good idea! It's been looking after us all year long, after all.

999008199.text:
ん？　あれって……なんだろう？
何かの像……かな？

localizations.en: Hm? What's that... I wonder? Some kind of statue... maybe?

999008199.text: ねぇ、ランターナの年末年始ってさ……

localizations.en: Hey, what do people in Lantarna do for the new year...

999008199.text: え。レスナ？　どうしたの？
ねぇ、レスナってば！？
